import os
import json
import sys
from cyhole.helius import Helius

# Read API key from environment variable
api_key = os.getenv("HELIUS_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable is not set")

# Initialize Helius client
helius = Helius(api_key=api_key)

# Asset ID to fetch metadata for (use command line arg or default example)
asset_id = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "4ZkS7zADmEFnkLPMHqJfPvHDN8oqfPjqDFGEQHiqPbEz"

# Fetch full DAS metadata synchronously
response = helius.client.post_get_asset(asset_id)

# Access the full metadata via response.result
metadata = response.result

# Print the full metadata
print(json.dumps(metadata.model_dump(), indent=2))
